emails.subject: Baby shower cake quote - Meadowlark Bakes
emails.body: Hi! For the shower on August 8 I can do a two-tier Lemon-Raspberry cake that serves sixteen for $68. Just reply confirming the flavor and you're on my calendar for that Saturday - I only bake two cakes a weekend so the sooner the better.

emails.subject: Balloon arch for Aug 8 - need your delivery hour
emails.body: Your sage-and-cream balloon arch is built and comes to $95. I can deliver any hour that Saturday morning - reply with the delivery time that works and I'll route the van. No reply, no van!
